meta.name: design-mobile-apps
meta.description: Use when the user wants to design a mobile app or UI screens, when they mention their Sleek (sleek.design) projects, or when implementing Sleek designs in code (HTML, React Native, SwiftUI).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把移动应用的想法变成可交付的界面设计稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在设计移动应用界面,还想把设计直接实现成代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a mobile app idea into deliverable interface designs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're designing mobile app screens and want them built in code.

howto.what: 它会通过 Sleek(sleek.design)API 建项目,把你的自然语言描述变成移动端界面并截图给你看;需要时还能取组件 HTML 代码用于实现。
howto.when: 当你想设计移动 App 或 UI 界面、提到自己的 Sleek 项目,或要把 Sleek 设计实现成代码(HTML、React Native、SwiftUI)时触发。

say.text: 用 Sleek 设计一个记账 App,含首页和明细页
say.note: 会建项目并把生成的界面截图发给你

say.text: 把这套设计导出成 HTML 代码给我
say.note: 会取组件 HTML 源码写成本地文件

say.text: 列出 Sleek 的设计参考风格让我挑
say.note: 会列出参考及其预览图供你选一个

howto.what_en: It calls the Sleek (sleek.design) API to create a project, turn your plain-language description into mobile screens, and screenshot them for you; it can also fetch component HTML code for implementation.
howto.when_en: When you want to design a mobile app or UI screens, mention your Sleek projects, or implement Sleek designs in code (HTML, React Native, SwiftUI).

say_en.text: Design a budgeting app in Sleek with a home and detail screen
say_en.note: Creates a project and shows you screenshots

say_en.text: Export this design as HTML code for me
say_en.note: Fetches component HTML into local files

say_en.text: List Sleek's design references so I can pick one
